notes.title: Update Log
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
①Older save files stuck at a certain level can now return to the current main storyline scene via [Menu] -> [Settings] -> [Scene Rollback].
②Fixed a bug where using the "Information Question" and then selecting "Credibility" resulted in negative action values.

Optimizations:
①Added tier labels to certain disguise actions.
②In the second playthrough, tutorial levels can be skipped. However, if the old save file is at or before the tutorial level, that level must be completed to proceed.
③Deck and encyclopedia unlocks from the first playthrough are carried over to the second. New cards are no longer awarded for winning main storyline levels in the second playthrough.
④Side quest rewards and their unlock status from the first playthrough are carried over. Completed side quests from the first playthrough can be experienced again without affecting reward acquisition.
⑤For players who started a second playthrough and saved their game before this update, clicking on [Deck]/[Encyclopedia]/[Report] in the old save will unlock all cards. If the "Scholarly" achievement was not unlocked, it will be unlocked automatically, and all side quests can be experienced again.

notes.title: Update Log
notes.notes:
Thank you all players for your attention and support to the project. After receiving your feedback, the production team will make every effort to optimize it!
Some content has been optimized. The update log is as follows:

1、Bug Fixes

①Fixed a bug where the game would freeze after revisiting a side quest (not reversible in old saves).
②Resolved an issue with erratic spacing in scouting instructions.
③Addressed a problem where pressing space during a video would skip two lines.
④Fixed the issue where exiting a battle using question 9 caused the card deck button to turn grey.
⑤Adjusted the "Discard Doubt" action to allow cancellation when selecting the second target.
⑥Restored icons in case data after revisiting plot through flashback.
⑦Fixed an issue where scrolling in one encyclopedia tab would affect the position in other tabs.
⑧Addressed a recurring problem during the card deck tutorial when exiting.

2、Optimizations

①Adjusted the placement of some dialogues in the video playback version.
②Added an invalid sound effect for the start of the turn card invalidation, question shielding, and analysis shielding.
③Implemented auto-save when returning to the cover after the end credits video.
④Modified some texts in the newbie guide and scene dialogues.
⑤Replaced the skeletal animation of the character Miyuki Miyabe.
⑥Added hover sound effects only to disguise actions with skill effects.
⑦Unlocked all encyclopedia entries and optimized unlocking logic in the second playthrough.
⑧Improved the trimming of BUFF icons.
⑨Enhanced the card deck manager tutorial to allow continuation by clicking the left BD.

3、Feature Additions

①Added the ability to skip story recaps.
②Implemented an exclamation mark notification for unclaimed rewards on the "Report" button.
③Made it possible to return from side quest scenes accessed through the report.

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.notes:
Dear players, if you have early access to our "Pre-Release Alternative Serial Number" for testing, please take note!

Firstly, we thank you for your valuable comments and feedback on "Card Detective." The development team has made a series of modifications and optimizations to the project based on your feedback.

If you are a player who previously had Steam permissions and installed the game, you may encounter issues with this update. You will need to delete the local folder and uninstall then reinstall the game.

Here are the instructions for the update process:

1.Right-click on the game in Steam, go to Properties, and turn off Steam Cloud.
2.Right-click, choose Manage, browse local files, and delete the folder.
3.Right-click, choose Manage, uninstall the game, and then reinstall it.
4.To overwrite cloud saves: Run the game, save in all four slots, then open cloud saves while the game is running.
